subject.title: Bug: unresolvable chat session key retries forever instead of settling on not-found

question: When a chat URL resolves to a missing session, should the Control UI retain the URL and render a not-found view, or clear the active selection and route to an empty/start view?
rationale: Both behaviors stop the retry loop, but the visible recovery destination and browser-navigation semantics are product choices not established by the supplied current-main contract.

options.title: Render route-level not found
options.body: Keep the attempted URL visible, mark the route terminally unresolved, and provide in-app navigation back to a valid session.

options.title: Clear selection to start view
options.body: Discard the missing active key and replace the route with the normal empty or start screen.

recommendation.title: Render route-level not found
recommendation.body: Keep the attempted URL visible, mark the route terminally unresolved, and provide in-app navigation back to a valid session.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently authored the session URL resolver and can align the failure state with its intended navigation contract.
